verdict.rationale: Alloy's docs have an SDK section ('Explore the different features of our SDK'), and a separate Web SDK changelog shows a first-party Web SDK exists. Nothing describes which languages or platforms are covered, how to install it, or what it can do. The 'Try It!' code snippets are generated request examples, not SDKs. Missing for 10: documented SDK languages and coverage, server-side SDKs, install and usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
